svg.title: EP2 C4 AREA 22
svg.desc: Seabed forces dangerous split play. Finish each group's mechanisms and pickups before confirming the advance. Everyone starts together and loops counterclockwise through rooms 1→9; ignore hallway enemies whenever you can. The Scape Doll at the end requires breaking a wall. Clear the Dolmolms in room 2, go south past the hallway Sinow and take warp 1→1′. In room 3 clear everything except the Recoboxes, then go south. On the room 4 bridge destroy the second Recobox to continue, and clear the hallway enemies. Clear the Sinows in room 5 and go east. In room 6 break the barrier, destroy the Recoboxes spawning Recons, then go east. Clear the Dolmolms and Sinows in room 7, go north into warp 2→2′. Clear the Deldepths in room 8 and go north; in room 9 destroy the Recoboxes spawning Recons and reach the exit. Scape Doll: in the exit room step on the orange switch, break the green wall to the north to reach room 1, take 3→3′ to the doll, then 4→4′ back to the exit.
